channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about World Championship | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about World Championship from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Nash on World Championship
item.description:
Steve Nash:

“Let me stop you on Schröder — he’s a Hall of Famer. Think about it. MVP of the World Championship, MVP of the Euros, finalist or semi-finalist in the Olympics... If that’s not a FIBA Hall of Famer, then what is? That’s pro résumé material. What do you think?”

Steve Nash on World Championship, Oct 8, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Andres Nocioni on World Championship
item.description:
“I told him that I was not going to do it because I thought I could play. I also knew my body and, although it was not at one hundred percent, it could reach 80%.I also told him that playing at the World Championship would let me be ready to play the season in Philadelphia,”

Andres Nocioni on World Championship, May 1, 2020. Source: Basquet Plus.

item.title: Stephen Curry on World Championship
item.description:
“He did a move in the 2010 World Championship where he shot a three off of one leg, and I wanted to copy that move.”

Stephen Curry on World Championship, Sep 15, 2018. Source: Sportando.

item.title: Pau Gasol on World Championship
item.description:
Pau Gasol:

“The last World Championship was a humbling experience for all of us:The team, the Spanish Federation, everyone involved at the time.”

Pau Gasol on World Championship, Aug 30, 2015. Source: Gigantes del Basket.

item.title: Pau Gasol on World Championship
item.description:
Pau Gasol:

“I will play the World Championship if the National Team coach wants me to.”

Pau Gasol on World Championship, Apr 23, 2014. Source: As.

item.title: Dominique Wilkins on Shaquille O'Neal, World Championship
item.description:
Dominique Wilkins today reflected on his time with USA Basketball:

“That was a great time. Dream Team II was unbelievable. That was an unbelievable team and to be with a lot of those guys, who I call characters now, Shaquille was a character. That was an unbelievable team and that was a great time to be a part of USA Basketball, to stand on that podium, to receive those gold medals pretty much killing everybody. There was nobody even close to us in that World Championship series. It was fun.”

Dominique Wilkins on Shaquille O'Neal, World Championship, Feb 16, 2013. Source: Facebook.com.
